message.content: {"issues":[{"number":6,"field":"visual_description","problem":"The weather-map front symbology is not transcribed faithfully enough: the source shows a specific sequence and side-placement of triangular and semicircular frontal symbols along the front(s), whereas the description only broadly assigns triangles to a western part and semicircles to an eastern part. This omits the visible configuration needed to distinguish the front types."},{"number":8,"field":"visual_description","problem":"The description omits the horizontal motion arrows shown above the plate boundaries, including the opposing directions for plates A/B and B/C. These visible plate-motion relationships are consequential to interpreting the boundary processes."}],"checked_numbers":[6,7,8,9,10,11]}
